notes.title: Independent before collaborative
notes.body: Keep first-pass findings private to each reviewer. This reduces anchoring and gives the coordinator three independent attempts at finding the same classes of failure.

notes.title: Evidence wins the disagreement
notes.body: Use confirmed, disputed, rejected, and needs-validation states. Three matching opinions are weaker than one reproducible counterexample. Keep the reason for the final disposition.

notes.title: Spend the second round carefully
notes.body: Send concrete claims and counterevidence to a fresh child task. Rerun only the disputed or changed scope, and leave untested claims visible when the budget is exhausted.
